episodes.name: Part 1
episodes.overviewEn: Cisco works late at night attempting to improve the Flash's suit to make it more bullet proof and odor resistant.

episodes.name: Part 2
episodes.overviewEn: An unexpected intruder threatens Cisco while he is working late one night at S.T.A.R. labs.

episodes.name: Part 3
episodes.overviewEn: While holding Cisco at gunpoint, Peek-a-Boo demands that Cisco make her a customized gun which will suit her needs.

episodes.name: Part 4
episodes.overviewEn: The line between reality and dreams is blurred when Cisco questions his encounter with Peek-a-Boo.
